decisions.statement: The values a seat says now win over the values its history held.
History fills only the values a seat no longer says.
A seat short of any value its page needs is a seat to recover.
A seat's assignment is kept as the page type and the slug both.
Each observed key is copied from the page back into the record beside that page.
A value the seat asks to clear is dropped rather than carried forward.

definition: all a seat says of itself, gathered in one read and filled from history
